summary: AlembicCore P1/P2 Plan authority repair completed in commit fe563ee8c6611a32714cef2bc328ca2ee08114c0. Core Plan draft packaging is facts-only: buildPlanDraftInformationPackage no longer emits authoritative PlanIntent or maps recommendedDimensions/dimensionOrder into dimensions/stages/moduleBindings/scale. PlanRepository draft save now writes a plugin-collected-facts placeholder intent and stop-writes planning_brief_json; confirm requires a complete Agent-authored PlanIntent and rationale, normalizes draftSource to host-agent, validates dimensions, stages, moduleBindings, scale/budgets, plannedNextActions, and evidenceRefs, and keeps generation state as read-time projection. Added canonical confirmed-Plan dimension resolution API resolvePlanDimensionDefinitions through domain/dimension, public dimensions export, and BaseDimensions adapter so downstream generation can resolve confirmed Plan ids without legacy resolveActiveDimensions/no-signal shrinkage. Updated characterization tests for facts-only draft, required complete confirm payload, persisted complete intent, read-time generation-state projection, and confirmed Plan id dimension resolution.
